name: Cache
description: Tells you each time that the prompt cache did not engage. The plugin monitors each provider request and its response. It looks for a response that did not read the cache of the turn before. Then it sends one `cache.didBreak` event and one diagnostic with the source `cache.break`, and adds no text to the system prompt. It also sends a diagnostic with the source `cache.anomaly` for the cause, not each time. The limits are in the `README.md` file, with the `target.didSwitch` event.
